// Package goodpkg is a synthetic KNOWN-GOOD fixture for
// collectionprefix_conformance_test.go's
// TestEveryStoreConstructionRoutesThroughSeam. It stands in for a real
// Qdrant-backed test package written in the "elsewhere" (qualified
// store.New) style internal/server, internal/e2e, and
// internal/retrievaleval all use. Every construction of the store's New
// constructor routes through the local newTestStore seam below and passes
// the collection name as an IDENTIFIER (the `name` parameter), never a
// literal — so this fixture must scan clean: zero findings.
//
// This file carries a .go.txt extension deliberately: it is parsed from
// source bytes by go/parser, never built by `go build`/gofmt/go vet/the
// linter, so it is not swept by any of them.
package goodpkg

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/qdrant/go-client/qdrant"
	"github.com/seanb4t/engram/internal/store"
)

const testCollectionPrefix = "goodpkg_"

func testCollection(name string) string {
	return testCollectionPrefix + name
}

// newTestStore is the ONLY call site in this fixture that invokes the raw
// store.New constructor. Its collection argument is the parameter `name`
// — an identifier, clean by this gate's rule, since plan 01-05's runtime
// seam (mirrored here by the prefix check) is what verifies the VALUE;
// this gate only forces every construction through it.
func newTestStore(t testing.TB, c *qdrant.Client, name string) *store.Store {
	t.Helper()
	if len(name) < len(testCollectionPrefix) || name[:len(testCollectionPrefix)] != testCollectionPrefix {
		t.Fatalf("collection name %q does not carry this package's prefix %q", name, testCollectionPrefix)
	}
	return store.New(c, name)
}

func TestGoodPkgUsesSeam(t *testing.T) {
	var c *qdrant.Client
	s := newTestStore(t, c, testCollection("example"))
	_ = s
}
